 Room Attendant - Hotel Rooms (Day Shifts) | 5-star hotel - Kaatsheuvel (Tilburg/Waalwijk region) - The Keepers - 3 weken geleden 
You start your shift while the day begins. Guests have checked out, and you prepare rooms so new guests can arrive in a clean and well-prepared space. Fresh beds, everything in place. 
About the location 
You'll work in a newly opened 5-star hotel in Kaatsheuvel, in the Tilburg/Waalwijk region. Everything is new, from the rooms to the design. 
Guests are mainly families. You'll be part of an international team where English is the main language. 
The role 
You work daytime shifts from 10:00 to 15:30. You prepare rooms within a clear schedule, with time pressure between check-out and check-in. The workload is more manageable compared to large city hotels. 
You'll be trained on the job and gradually work independently. Quality is checked by a supervisor. 
What will you do? - Clean hotel rooms - Change and make beds - Prepare rooms for new guests - Perform stayover service - Check rooms for quality - Report issues - Assist guests if needed 
Who are we looking for? - You speak Dutch and/or English - You are available at least 16 hours per week - You can work weekends and holidays - You work accurately and independently - Experience is a plus, motivation is more important 
What do we offer? - €17.67 per hour (including holiday pay and vacation days) - Travel allowance of €0.23 per km - Day shifts from 10:00 to 15:30 - Flexible planning - 13th month bonus (paid in December) - Temporary contract - Possibility of a direct contract over time - With consistent availability: chance to receive a subscription 
Closing

 Mail carrier Sevenum 
 - 
 Wat ga je doen? 
As a part-time mail carrier at PostNL in Sevenum, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. You can organise your own schedule, which makes this job very flexible. 
Your day starts at the depot in your neighbourhood, where you collect the mail for your route. You sort the letters and get your bike ready. Then you're ready to go! You cycle through the streets in your area and deliver mail to the correct addresses. Along the way, you enjoy the fresh air and often have a chat with people you meet. 
This vacancy is for 3 hours per day from Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, which adds up to 9 hours per week. You can choose your own starting time, as long as all mail is delivered before 6:00 PM. This gives you the freedom to organise your work in the way that suits you best. 
Are you 16 years or older, do you speak Dutch or English, and do you enjoy being outdoors? Apply now and start delivering letters and cards in one of our neighbourhoods in the region soon! 
Please note: the position is initially until the end of September. 
 Waar ga je werken? 
You will be working at PostNL, the largest postal and parcel company in the Netherlands. Every day, they ensure that millions of letters and parcels are delivered to the right destination, both within the Netherlands and abroad. 
As a mail carrier, you work independently. You start your day by collecting the mail and have until 6:00 PM to sort and deliver everything. This allows you to largely determine your own pace and how you organise your day. 
The location is accessible from Venray, Horst, America, Hegelsom, Meterik, Sevenum, Melderslo and Grubbenvorst. Do you live in one of these places? If so, you may even be able to cycle to the depot. Do you enjoy working independently outdoors and making people happy with their mail? Then this is the perfect job for you!

Turndown Cleaning Housekeeping Evening - Hotel De L'Europe Amsterdam 
 Jouw baan 
You will work in the evening at Hotel De L'Europe in Amsterdam. You prepare the hotel rooms for the night. You work from 17:30 to 21:30 for 15-20 hours per week. The Housekeeping Supervisor explains your daily work and helps you when needed. 
Key Responsibilities: - Tidy and freshen up the hotel rooms - Prepare the beds for the night - Replace used towels - Fill up soap, shampoo and other guest items - Empty the waste bins - Close the curtains and prepare the room for sleeping - Report broken or missing items to the supervisor - Be friendly and polite when you meet hotel guests 
 Wij bieden 
 - A gross hourly wage from €15.52, depending on your work experience* - Salary every four weeks, which means 13 payments per year - €0.14 travel allowance per kilometre if you travel at least 20 kilometres per day - 8% holiday pay, 10% holiday hours and a 5% end-of-year bonus - A seven-month contract with a one-month trial period and the possibility of extension - An extra day off on your birthday and help from experienced colleagues 
*The hourly wage applies to employees aged 20 and over. 
 EW Facility Services 
For over 30 years, EW Facility Services has provided cleaning and maintenance services for hotels, offices, hospitals and other buildings. Our more than 3,000 employees work at locations throughout the Netherlands. Together, we create a clean and welcoming environment for our clients, their guests and visitors. 
 Jij bent 
 - Available for 15-20 hours per week, from 17:30 to 21:30 - Flexible and available on different days, including weekends - Able to speak English - Careful and able to see what needs to be done - Able to work alone and as part of a team - Living in Amsterdam or nearby 
Cleaning experience is helpful, but not required
